name: Telecommunication and network infrastructure
description: Telecommunication and network infrastructure for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Procurement / I&C. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts. Primary source: https://cache.industry.siemens.com/dl/files/345/109766345/att_980971/v1/ruggedcom_ethernet_layer_2_switches_en.pdf

specifications.metric: Siemens RUGGEDCOM 19-inch Layer 2 Ethe — standards compliance
specifications.basis: Siemens RUGGEDCOM 19” Layer 2 Ethernet Switches brochure, Edition 09/2018, © Siemens AG 2018, read via r.jina.ai: 'All RUGGEDCOM switches meet and exceed recognized industry standards (e.g. IEC 61850-3, IEEE 1613, NEMA TS 2)'. (value: IEC 61850-3, IEEE 1613 Class 2, NEMA TS 2)

specifications.metric: Siemens RUGGEDCOM 19-inch Layer 2 Ethe — operating temperature
specifications.basis: Siemens RUGGEDCOM brochure, Edition 09/2018, read via r.jina.ai: '-40°C to +85°C operating temperature (no fans)'.

specifications.metric: Siemens RUGGEDCOM 19-inch Layer 2 Ethe — RSG2100 port count
specifications.basis: Siemens RUGGEDCOM brochure, Edition 09/2018, read via r.jina.ai: 'Up to 19 ports: 3 x 10/100/1000BASE-X ports; 16 x 10/100BASE-X ports'.

specifications.metric: Siemens RUGGEDCOM 19-inch Layer 2 Ethe — RSG2300 port count
specifications.basis: Siemens RUGGEDCOM brochure, Edition 09/2018, read via r.jina.ai: 'The RUGGEDCOM RSG2300 is a utility-grade, fully managed, 32-port modular Ethernet switch'.

specifications.metric: Siemens RUGGEDCOM 19-inch Layer 2 Ethe — RST2228 uplink speed
specifications.basis: Siemens RUGGEDCOM brochure, Edition 09/2018, read via r.jina.ai: '4 x 1000BASE-X/10GBASE-X uplinks' and '10 Gbit/s uplinks'.

specifications.metric: Siemens RUGGEDCOM 19-inch Layer 2 Ethe — redundancy protocols
specifications.basis: Siemens RUGGEDCOM brochure, Edition 09/2018, read via r.jina.ai: table listing 'RSTP (IEEE 802.1D-2004), eRSTP™', 'MRP (IEC 62439-2)', 'HSR and PRP Redundancy Protocols (IEC 62439-3)', 'IEEE 1588v2 time synchronization'. (value: RSTP/eRSTP, MSTP, MRP (IEC 62439-2), HSR/PRP (IEC 62439-3), IEEE 1588v2)

specifications.metric: Siemens RUGGEDCOM 19-inch Layer 2 Ethe — universal supply range
specifications.basis: Siemens RUGGEDCOM brochure, Edition 09/2018, read via r.jina.ai: 'Universal high-voltage range: 88–300 VDC or 85–264 VAC'.

specifications.metric: Siemens RUGGEDCOM 19-inch Layer 2 Ethe — PoE capability (RST2228P)
specifications.unit: PoE ports, max 60 W per port, 500 W shared budget
specifications.basis: Siemens RUGGEDCOM brochure, Edition 09/2018, read via r.jina.ai: 'Up to 24 PoE Ports ... Maximum power per port is 60 Watt ... 500 Watt shared power budget per device'.

specifications.metric: SESB communication link for revenue me — communication link availability target
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code MC6.1 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'target availability of the communication link shall be 95% per annum unless otherwise agreed between the Single Buyer and the User'.

specifications.metric: SESB communication link for revenue me — regulatory approval of telecom equipment
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code MC6.2 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'the communication link and the associated equipment procured is approved under the relevant telecommunication laws and regulations'. (value: communication link and associated equipment procured must be approved under rele)
Operation in industrial temperature range: -40 degC to +85 degC normal operation; passive cooling - no fans
Universal high-voltage range: 88-300 VDC or 85-264 VAC
Universal high-voltage range: 88-300 VDC or 85-264 VAC
Low voltage: 12 VDC, 24 VDC or 48 VDC
RUGGEDCOM RSG2100: Up to 19 ports: 3 x 10/100/1000BASE-X; 16 x 10/100BASE-X; 2 port modules
RUGGEDCOM RSG2300: Up to 32 ports: 4 x optional 10/100/1000BASE-X; 4 x optional 10/100BASE-X; 24 x fixed 10/100BASE-TX
RUGGEDCOM RST2228: 4 x 1000BASE-X/10GBASE-X uplinks; up to 24 x 10/100/1000BASE-X ports; IEEE 1588 v2 hardware time stamping
RUGGEDCOM RSG2488: 28 x 10/100/1000BASE-X ports; 4 port field replaceable modules; IEEE 1588, SNTP, IRIG-B and GPS conversion
RST2228P: Up to 24 PoE ports; maximum power per port is 60 Watt; 500 Watt shared power budget per device
500 Watt shared power budget per device (RST2228P)

gaps.why: No project-specific telecom network topology, fibre core count, radio links, switch quantities, bandwidth or price was found in any page read.
gaps.next_action: Request SESB Grid Owner communication guidelines and the project telecom/network BOQ and single-line diagram.

gaps.why: No printed telecommunication/network infrastructure contract value or $/point, $/km or MYR rate for the 7-unit SESB-connected plant was found.
gaps.next_action: Find the plant's ICT/network package BOQ or award notice and record its dated value, quantities and currency exactly as printed.

gaps.why: No publisher page with printed material properties (grade, alloy, insulation, coating or catalyst composition) for this item was actually read.
gaps.next_action: Obtain the vendor material certificate or datasheet with printed properties and read it before recording any value.

notes: Analysed core item from the owner-supplied equipment/facilities list for a 7-unit gas-engine power plant. Evidence categories present: sources, specifications, vendors, catalogue models. Checked for prices, projects, standards, patents, drawings and materials; where absent the gaps record says so.
